name: CSO_REPUTATION_REW_QUEUE
description: This table stores transient details of how many reputations rewards a user has been awarded. The rows in this table will be deleted after the view count is merged in to USERINFORMATION table for each user. assert( NOT_NULL(CALCULATEDPOINTS) or NOT_NULL(REWARDMULTIPLIERTYPE, POINTSPERREWARD, REWARDTYPE, TIMESREWARDED) )

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was added to the repository.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was modified.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID for the associated user.

columns.name: IS_ADD
columns.description: Flag indicating whether points need to be added or subtracted.

columns.name: CALCULATED_POINTS
columns.description: The (incremental) number of points which need to be added to or subtracted from the user's reputation points. No further calculations are needed if this column is populated.

columns.name: POINTS_PER_REWARD
columns.description: This is the number of points for this reward (before any multipliers are applied). Generally positive value.

columns.name: REWARD_TYPE
columns.description: This is the type of ReputationReward (REWARD_CONTENT_AUTHORED, etc).

columns.name: TIMES_REWARDED
columns.description: This is the number of times this type of reward is rewarded (or to be taken away). Positive value.

columns.name: OPTIMISTIC_FAILURE_COUNT
columns.description: The count of optimistic locking failures faced when merging this record into CONTENTMETRICs.

columns.name: OTHER_FAILURE_COUNT
columns.description: The count of other failures faced when merging this record into CONTENTMETRICs.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID of the associated user.
